description.en: Builds the Docker image, starts compose stack, runs smoke test, and waits for user approval before continuing. Requires a SaaS factory in the project (directory saas-factory/ or FACTORY_ROOT with the CLI tools/factory); it is not part of this repository.
description.de: Baut das Docker-Image, startet den Compose-Stack, macht einen Smoke-Test und wartet auf User-Approval. Voraussetzung: eine SaaS-Factory im Projekt (Verzeichnis saas-factory/ oder FACTORY_ROOT mit der CLI tools/factory); sie gehört nicht zu diesem Repository.

author: MySuricates
instructions: Containerization is deterministic — no LLM steps. Uses the factory CLI. Approval at the end, because the user should look at the running app.

config.command:
set -euo pipefail
FACTORY="${FACTORY_ROOT:-./saas-factory}"
SLUG="{{ slug }}"
TARGET="$FACTORY/$SLUG"
"$FACTORY/tools/factory" build-container "$TARGET" --smoke

config.question:
## Container is running

{{ previous_output }}

The app is now running locally. Look at it in the browser — the port is in the JSON above.

**Yes** = end the pipeline, the app is OK
**No** = end the pipeline, the app is NOT OK (opens a TODO for manual review)
**Restart** = stop the container and rebuild it (e.g. after code edits)

config.command:
set -euo pipefail
FACTORY="${FACTORY_ROOT:-./saas-factory}"
DECISION="{{ containerize_decision }}"
SLUG="{{ slug }}"
if [ "$DECISION" = 'No' ]; then
  "$FACTORY/tools/factory" create-todo "Manual review needed: $SLUG rejected after containerize" --tag manual-review --tag "$SLUG" --priority HIGH --workflow-run '{{ workflow_run_id }}' --reference-type 'containerize_rejected' --reference-id "$SLUG" >&2 || true
fi
echo "Decision: $DECISION"
